ShikkhaOSApp flow
The flow

From classroom to the student’s phone

Four people, one chain. Each step is visible to the next person.

Step 1
Teacher
  • Takes attendance
  • Enters marks
  • Submits to the Register
Step 2
Register
  • Reviews each submission
  • Requests a correction if needed
  • Verifies and compiles the result
Step 3
Headmaster
  • Checks the compiled result
  • Approves, or sends it back
  • Publishes to students
Step 4
Student & Guardian
  • Student gets a notification
  • Opens own result and report card
  • Guardian views it with the student

Locked after submit

Marks cannot be changed quietly.

Two people decide

The one who verifies cannot approve.

Published is final

Any change is a new, visible revision.

Teacher

Teacher: attendance, marks, submit

A teacher sees only their own classes and subjects.

1
Open dashboardToday’s work and any correction request
2
Take attendancePresent, absent, late in seconds
3
Enter marksInvalid marks rejected on the spot
4
SubmitMarks lock and go to the Register
If the Register finds a problem: the teacher sees the reason and the flagged rows, fixes them and submits again as a new revision.

Headmaster: review, approve, publish

The Register prepares the result. The Headmaster decides.

1
See what is waitingDashboard shows pending approvals

ShikkhaOSApp flow
Student & guardian

What the student — and guardian — see

Students see only their own information. A guardian can view it together with the student.

1
Notification“Your result is published”
2
Open resultSubject marks, GPA, grade, position
3
Download report cardPDF to keep or share with the guardian
4
Stay informedAttendance, homework and notices
Guardians: in this first release a guardian has no separate login. They see results through the student’s account or the report card PDF; guardian phone numbers are stored for school contact.
